locator: p. 222, Figure 11 'Envelopes of minimum and maximum of normal stresses due to bending moments'
extremes_height_m: near 1170 m (labelled height of the envelope spikes); the riser head is at 1200 m

attribution.basis: Visual line-style reading of the 300 dpi scan. Right side (minimum envelope): the solid spike reaches the -31.40 label and the dashed spike ends at the -22.45 label - clear. Left side (maximum envelope): the dashed spike extends furthest, to the +27.20 label, and +26.24 sits at the solid spike - less certain because the two spikes overlap.

text_claim: p. 222: 'As can be seen in Fig. 11 the linear-structure analysis underestimates the stresses near the riser head by about 15% as compared to the nonlinear structure analysis.'
